<CAPTION>
A minimalist stick-figure style illustration depicts a human-like figure standing on a flat green ground plane against a solid light blue background, with a single yellow circle in the upper right corner representing the sun. The figure has a beige circular head with two black dots for eyes and a simple curved line forming a smile; it wears a red sleeveless top, dark blue pants, and has pale peach-colored arms extending from its sides. The body is composed of basic geometric shapes: a rounded head atop a rectangular torso that connects to straight legs ending in flat feet, all outlined with thin black lines. There are no facial features beyond the eyes and mouth, no hands or shoes visible, and no other objects or scenery present. The composition centers the figure vertically against the plain background, viewed from eye level without perspective distortion. Lighting appears uniform across the scene, suggesting a bright daytime setting implied by the sun symbol.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized cartoon figure with a brown bob haircut, beige face, black dot eyes, and a simple smile stands centered on a flat green ground against a solid light blue background. The character wears a plain red sleeveless top over dark blue pants and has pale peach-colored arms and legs. Eight white speech bubbles with rounded corners are arranged around the figure—four to its left and four to its right—with small triangular pointers indicating their origin from off-frame. Each bubble contains identical text: “There is still a lot to discuss. Let us talk about it tomorrow.” The first line in each bubble varies, including phrases like “Meet me near the old bridge,” “Remember to bring your notebook,” “I have already packed the map,” “Did you remember the red ticket?”, “The blue parcel arrives at noon,” “We can walk along the river,” “Please wait beside the station,” and “The small cafe closes at sunset.” The overall style is minimalist 2D vector illustration with clean black outlines, flat colors without shading or texture, and no visible camera angle or lighting effects.
</CAPTION>
